"""Preserve full successful Rust validation and the failed strict-profile audit."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W = P.parent / 'friendly-hortative-sena'
OUT = W / 'docs/friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-validation-proof-archive.json'
assert not OUT.exists()
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
passed = json.loads((P / 'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-full-rust.json').read_bytes())
assert passed['state'] == 'passed' and passed['rust_totals'] == dict(passed=1212, failed=0, ignored=1)
assert passed['rust_batches'] == 263 and len(passed['all_targets']) == 262 and len(passed['results']) == 267
assert all(r['exit_code'] == 0 for r in passed['results'])
assert all(passed[k] for k in ['inputs_unchanged', 'head_unchanged', 'index_unchanged', 'protected_binaries_unchanged'])
assert all(sha((W/name).read_bytes()) == digest for name,digest in passed['frozen_inputs'].items())
failed = json.loads((P / 'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-controls.json').read_bytes())
assert failed['state'] == 'failed' and len(failed['results']) == 1 and failed['results'][0]['exit_code'] == 1
names = ['run_sena_gena_parent_full_rust.py', 'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-full-rust.json',
         'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-full-rust.log', 'validate_sena_gena_parent_controls.py',
         'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-controls.json', 'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-controls.log',
         'sena-gena-parent-first-controls-failure-originals.json', 'sena-gena-parent-exact-compile-profile-delta.json',
         'friendly_hortative_sena_gena_parent_audit.py', 'sena-gena-parent-running-evidence-rejection.json',
         'sena-gena-parent-guard-running-tested-original.py.gz',
         'validate_sena_gena_parent_draft_guard.py',
         'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-draft-guard-controls.json',
         'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-draft-guard-controls.log',
         'test_friendly_hortative_sena_gena_parent_audit.py']
draft = json.loads((P/'friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-draft-guard-controls.json').read_bytes())
assert draft['state']=='passed' and draft['controls']==14 and all(draft[k] for k in ['source_unchanged','head_unchanged','index_unchanged','protected_binaries_unchanged'])
originals = json.loads((P / 'sena-gena-parent-first-controls-failure-originals.json').read_bytes())
paths = {name:P/name for name in names}
for row in originals['files'].values():
    path = Path(row['path']); packed = path.read_bytes()
    assert sha(packed) == row['archive_sha256'] and sha(gzip.decompress(packed)) == row['source_sha256']
    paths[path.name] = path
files = {}; destination = W / 'docs/friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-validation-proof'; destination.mkdir()
for name,path in sorted(paths.items()):
    raw = path.read_bytes(); packed = gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0);target=destination/(name+'.gz');target.write_bytes(packed)
    assert gzip.decompress(target.read_bytes()) == raw
    files[name] = dict(path=str(target.relative_to(W/'docs')),source_sha256=sha(raw),archive_sha256=sha(packed),bytes=len(raw))
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='whole-parent-Rust-success-and-original-controls-failure-preserved',files=files,
                              head=passed['head'],full_rust_tests=1212,rust_batches=263,cargo_targets=262,
                              all_source_head_index_and_six_binaries_unchanged=True,
                              prepared_parent_guard_controls=14,original31_control_attempt_failed=True,original10_failures_remain_failed=True,
                              original25_Sena_cases_remain_private=True,
                              producer=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(),sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())),
                              scope='Actual full parent Rust proof. Original profile guard remains failed until exact parent binding is installed and all current/historical controls pass. Shared25promotion/main/Nix/quiet/contextual review remain separate.'),indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(files),manifest_sha256=sha(OUT.read_bytes()))))
